sys_script_fix.description: This script is introduced in the Illumio v2.0.0. We introduced the support of multiple label dimensions and introduced new tables and deprecated the old tables. To prevent the loss of existing data present in the old tables, we introduced the fix scripts to migrate the data present in the tables, while upgrading to the new version.
sys_script_fix.name: Add exisiting mapping to other table
